decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service builds on an established offer and fits the firm's strategy. A large, expanding firm has the slack to carry it while results remain uncertain, and there is no reported shortfall to prompt a search for other uses of the resources.

The call number routing platform sits close to the core business and already has its own web page, which suggests a satisfactory market position. With nothing indicating it falls short of aspirations, management has no reason to drop it.
